scripts.prestart: (npm run build:edu-sharing-api:dev & PID1=$!; npm run build:b-api & PID2=$!; npm run build:rendering-service-api:dev & PID3=$!; wait $PID1 || exit 1; wait $PID2 || exit 1; wait $PID3 || exit 1) && npm run build:edu-sharing-ui && npm run build:rendering-service-lib:dev && ln -sfn $(pwd)/dist/edu-sharing-api node_modules/ngx-edu-sharing-api && ln -sfn $(pwd)/dist/edu-sharing-ui node_modules/ngx-edu-sharing-ui && ln -sfn $(pwd)/dist/rendering-service-api node_modules/ngx-rendering-service-api && ln -sfn $(pwd)/dist/rendering-service-lib node_modules/ngx-rendering-service-lib
scripts.build:edu-sharing-api: (cd projects/edu-sharing-api && npm run update-if-needed) && node --max_old_space_size=2048 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build edu-sharing-api
scripts.build:b-api: (cd projects/b-api && npm run update-if-needed) && node --max_old_space_size=2048 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build b-api
scripts.build:rendering-service-api: (cd projects/rendering-service-api && npm run generate-api-if-needed) && node --max_old_space_size=2048 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build rendering-service-api
scripts.build:rendering-service-api:dev: (cd projects/rendering-service-api && npm run generate-api-if-needed) && node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build rendering-service-api --configuration development
scripts.build:edu-sharing-api:dev: (cd projects/edu-sharing-api && npm run update-if-needed) && node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build edu-sharing-api --configuration development
scripts.publish:edu-sharing-api: npm run build:edu-sharing-api && cd dist/edu-sharing-api && npm publish
scripts.prebuild: (npm run build:edu-sharing-api & PID1=$!; npm run build:b-api & PID2=$!; npm run build:rendering-service-api & PID3=$!; wait $PID1 || exit 1; wait $PID2 || exit 1; wait $PID3 || exit 1) && npm run build:edu-sharing-ui && npm run build:rendering-service-lib
scripts.analyze-build-bundle-size: npm run prebuild && ng build --configuration production --stats-json && jq -r '.inputs | to_entries[] | "\(.value.bytes/1024 | floor) KB \(.key)"' dist/stats.json | sort -nr
scripts.build: (npm run build:app-as-component & PID1=$!; npm run build:components & PID2=$!; wait $PID1 || exit 1; wait $PID2 || exit 1) && node --max_old_space_size=4096 ./node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build --configuration production --delete-output-path false --base-href /edu-sharing/
scripts.build:components: npm run build:components:pdf && npm run build:components:default
scripts.build:storybook: rm -rf dist/storybook && npm run build-storybook && mv dist/storybook/angular-edusharing/* dist/storybook && rm -rf dist/storybook/angular-edusharing
scripts.build-and-copy-to-docker: npm run build && npm run copy-build-to-docker
scripts.audit:fix: npm audit fix; git add package.json package-lock.json && (git diff --cached --quiet -- package.json package-lock.json || git commit -m "chore:npm audit" -- package.json package-lock.json)
scripts.prepare: cd .. && husky install Frontend/.husky && cd Frontend/src/app/core-module && git config core.hooksPath ../../../.husky || true
